authLost.title: This phone is no longer paired
authLost.hint: The host revoked its credential or was reinstalled. Pair again to keep going.

pair.title: Connect to your host
pair.hint: Agents run on the machine at home. This phone only steers them.
pair.tokenPlaceholder: Paste the token from the pair command
pair.browserOnly: Pairing works in the Android app. In the browser the dev server already holds a credential.
pair.how2: Copy the token it prints. The address is the host's Tailscale name with port 3775 (the Soloyard gateway).

error.network: Can't reach that address. Check that Tailscale is connected and the address and port are right.
error.auth: The credential is wrong or has been revoked. Pair again on the host.
error.protocol: The host runs a different version of the protocol. Update the host or the app.

home.noProjectsTitle: No projects on the host yet
home.noProjectsHint: Open a folder on the host and its sessions show up here.
home.noSessionsHint: Ask something below to start one.
home.noGateway: You're connected straight to the host service, so sessions from your computer don't show up. Pair with the Soloyard gateway (port 3775) to see them.

projects.title: Projects
projects.openFolder: Open a folder on the host…

model.title: Model
model.lockedHint: A session keeps its provider. To use another one, start a new session in the project.
model.afterTurn: The running turn keeps its model. The change applies when it finishes.

session.queued: Queued · sends when this turn ends
session.image: Generated an image (open on the desktop to view)
session.queuePlaceholder: Queue a message for after this turn…
session.modelQueued: Switches to {{name}} when this turn ends
session.onDesktop: This conversation moved to your computer. Continue it there, or pick it up again from the home screen.

mirror.hint: Your computer runs this. Watch it here.
mirror.offline: Your computer is offline (asleep, or Soloyard isn't open). You can send once it's back.

files.title: Files
files.empty: No files written in this session yet.
files.otherHint: This file can't be shown in the app. Open it with another app.

error.network: Can't reach the host. Check Tailscale and try again.
error.offline: Your computer is offline (asleep, or Soloyard isn't open), so the file can't be fetched.
error.timeout: Your computer didn't answer in time. Try again.
error.secret: Credential files can't be viewed on the phone.
error.outside: This file isn't in the session's project and wasn't mentioned in the conversation.
error.tooBig: The file is larger than 50 MB.
error.unsupported: Update the app to use this.
error.noTailscale: Tailscale isn't running on that computer, so the phone can't reach it.

files.pdfHint: Opens in your phone's PDF viewer.

merge.acceptHint: Merge this issue's worktree branch into its repository, then mark it done
merge.previewDirty_one: The worktree still has {{count}} uncommitted change — have the agent commit it first.
merge.previewDirty_other: The worktree still has {{count}} uncommitted changes — have the agent commit them first.
merge.dirtyWorktree_one: Not merged: {{branch}} has {{count}} uncommitted change ({{files}}). Send it back so the agent commits it.
merge.dirtyWorktree_other: Not merged: {{branch}} has {{count}} uncommitted changes ({{files}}). Send it back so the agent commits them.
merge.dirtyMain: Not merged: the main checkout of {{repo}} has uncommitted changes ({{files}}). Commit or stash them first.
merge.conflict: Not merged: {{branch}} conflicts with {{repo}}/{{target}} ({{files}}); the merge was backed out. Send it back so the agent merges {{target}} into its branch and resolves the conflicts.
merge.noTarget: Not merged: the main checkout of {{repo}} isn't on a branch.

prompt.begin: Before you start, use the Soloyard MCP tools to set {{ident}} to in_progress.
prompt.selfCheck: 1. Check each acceptance criterion and explain how you verified it (commands and results).
prompt.report: 2. Set {{ident}} to in_review and add a comment: what changed and how you verified it. Don't set it to done — I'll accept it.
prompt.sentBackMessage:
{{ident}} didn't pass review: {{reason}}

Please fix it, check again, then set the issue back to in_review and comment on what changed.
prompt.repo: Repository: {{name}} ({{path}}). This session works there; other repositories in the project are listed in the project map.
prompt.commitInWorktree: This session works in its own worktree: commit your changes to the current branch before setting the issue to in_review (don't merge or push). When I accept it, the app merges this branch into the repository's main branch.

issues.quickPlaceholder: New issue title, Enter adds it to {{iteration}}
issues.quickPlaceholderPlain: New issue title, Enter to create
issues.empty: No issues in this iteration yet.
issues.offline: Your computer is offline, so issues can't be shown.
issues.noProject: This folder isn't a Soloyard project on your computer yet.
issues.noSessions: No sessions yet. Starting work opens one on your computer.
issues.startHint: Opens a new session on your computer and sends the prompt right away.
issues.startHintRepo: Opens a new session in a new worktree of {{repo}} on your computer and sends the prompt right away.
issues.acceptHint: Merges its worktree branch into the main branch, then marks it done. Nothing changes if there are conflicts or the main checkout isn't clean.
issues.sendBackHint: Saved as a comment and sent to “{{title}}”.
issues.createHint: In {{project}}, added to the current iteration {{iteration}}
issues.createHintPlain: In {{project}}, added to the current iteration

notify.title: Notifications
notify.hint: When a session finishes or needs you
notify.blocked: Android isn't letting Soloyard post notifications. Turn them on in settings.
notify.background: On ColorOS, allow Soloyard to auto-launch and run in the background, or notifications stop once the screen locks.
notify.disconnected: Can't reach the host, so nothing will come through. Is Tailscale on? ({{reason}})
notify.stopped: Android paused Soloyard for {{minutes}} min from {{time}}, so notifications in that window were missed (usually ColorOS freezing background apps once the screen locks). In App info → Battery, allow full background activity and auto-launch.
